name: Google Kubernetes Engine

name: Cloud Interconnect

name: Cloud KMS

name: Looker

name: Managed Service for Apache Kafka

name: Network Connectivity Center

name: Private Service Connect

name: Pub/Sub

name: Secret Manager

name: Shared VPC network
description: The host project's network the workload projects attach to, with the tiers as subnetworks.

name: Lending External Load Balancer

name: HA VPN
description: The backup path to the data center: HA VPN over the internet, two tunnels with BGP, carrying the traffic when the Interconnect does not. Tested on the same quarterly failover as the Interconnect's second attachment.

name: Analytics Cloud NAT
description: Regional NAT for the Dataflow workers' egress to the package mirrors and nothing else; the data never leaves by it.

name: Lending Cloud NAT
description: Regional NAT for the private subnetworks' egress, the only way out that is not a Private Service Connect endpoint; one gateway per region, not one per zone.

name: Lending Proxy-only Subnetwork

name: Analytics Data Subnetwork

name: Analytics Data Subnetwork (DR)

name: Lending App Subnetwork

name: Lending App Subnetwork (DR)
description: The warm-standby region's application tier, empty until a failover; the same VPC, since a Google Cloud VPC is global, so no peering to maintain.

name: Lending Data Subnetwork
description: Cloud SQL's private services access range and the Memorystore endpoints; no route to the internet, in or out.
